goal: Pre-decide routine engineering choices, bind ecosystem rules automatically, and make version control a deterministic part of project execution.

alignment.evidence: Work is isolated on athena/engineering-defaults-v0.4 and targets only the reusable harness.
v0.3 contracts, WordPress Way, skill router, decision rights, old git-checkpoint.js, package scripts, tests, and external harness references were inspected.
00-PLANNING/SYSTEM-MODEL.md confirms the low-question engineering-default and deterministic-VCS problem model.
This slice changes harness policy/control only; no deployment, provider spend, production mutation, remote repository creation, force push, merge, or release is authorised.
ENGINEERING-DEFAULTS.md owns routine defaults, ecosystem skills own platform rules, vcs-control.js owns Git operations, and project-control remains the readiness/memory controller.
The first slice is engineering defaults, deterministic skill binding, one consolidated WordPress contract, a zero-dependency Git controller, and focused regression tests.

The design reuses Node 20+ and existing controllers, adds no runtime dependency, avoids embedding another harness, and leaves legacy git-checkpoint.js unsupported rather than routing new automation through it.
Implementation is on the v0.4 branch; full Node 20/22/24 GitHub Actions proof has not run yet.
